captions.detailed: A binocular telescope assembly consisting of two parallel white refractor tubes with black objective lens hoods, mounted on a dark gray alt-azimuth support system. The telescope is held by a wide black bridge frame that pivots vertically (altitude adjustment) on a single-arm yoke mount. This yoke rotates horizontally (azimuth adjustment) on a central vertical axis atop a sturdy dark gray tripod with three angled legs and cross-bracing.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a binocular telescope on a tripod mount. The design should feature two parallel white optical tubes with black end caps, supported by a single-arm alt-azimuth yoke that allows both panning (azimuth) and tilting (altitude) adjustments, all resting on a three-legged tripod with cross-brace supports.
captions.factory: Construct the tripod base using a central vertical cylinder for the column, angled cylinders for the legs, and thin rectangular boxes for the cross-braces. Model the single-arm yoke mount using a rotating base cylinder and an offset L-shaped assembly of rectangular boxes. Form the binocular optical assembly by placing two parallel cylinders (colored white) with slightly larger, shorter black cylinders at their ends, joined together by a flat rectangular mounting bridge connected to the altitude pivot axis.
